definitions.full: H2707. chaqah חָקָה verb only Pu`al cut in, carve (Late Hebrew represent, imitate ; || חקק ) — Pu`al Participle מְחֻקֶּה 1Kin 6:35 ; Ezek 8:10 + 23:14 (Co מְחֻקִּים , after ᵑ9 ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ), carved figure on wall 8:10 ; 23:14 (where read מחקים אנשׁים , see above) = substantive carved work 1Kin 6:35 (on doors of temple). Hithpa`el Imperfect 2masculine singular תִּתְחַקֶּה רַגְלַי עלשָֿׁרְשֵׁי Job 13:27 thou gravest thee a graving (= markest a line) for (i.e. about) the soles of my feet , fixest limits for them (see Di). חֻקָּה see below חקק . below
